candidates.change_summary: Replace the credit 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' with an assignment 'balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;', overwriting instead of accumulating the balance.
Delete the statement 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' so deposits never update the balance mapping.
Credit the contract's own address instead of the depositor: 'balances[address(this)] += msg.value;', so the caller's balance never increases.
Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so SetMinSum always sets MinSum to zero.
Delete the `require(!intitalized);` guard so MinSum can still be changed after initialization.
Replace `require(!intitalized)` with `require(intitalized)` so SetMinSum only works after initialization.
Remove the assignment `MinSum = _val;` so MinSum keeps its previous (default 0) value after calling SetMinSum.
Replace the assignment with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored value is always one greater than the argument.
Replace the assignment with `MinSum = 0;` so SetMinSum always ends up as 0 regardless of the argument.
Replace the assignment with `MinSum = ~_val;` so the stored value is the bitwise complement of the argument.
Replace the assignment with `MinSum = _val * 2;` so the stored value is double the argument.
Remove the statement that assigns the log file address, so Log stays address(0).
Assign msg.sender instead of _log to the Log variable.
Remove the require(!intitalized) guard so the log file can also be set after initialization.
